I've lived in 15 different rentals since moving out of home 13 years ago (wow where did the time go!) And I am now so careful about taking photos before moving in. I had one bad landlord who took advantage of clueless uni students and now I photograph every room, dent, smudge, paint mark haha. In Australia they have something called a property condition report, compiled by the landlord with photos and descriptions of every room including any damage, and when you move in they give you a copy and you have to sign and return within 7 days, but you can also amend and add things if you find additional stuff. Basically that report is an agreement from both parties on the condition of the rental, but I always take my own photos of any damage.
